hooks.name: pre-tool:tsc-on-ts-write
hooks.description: Run TypeScript strict check before any .ts write. Warns (non-blocking) so agent sees errors before writing.

hooks.name: post-tool:eslint-autofix
hooks.description: Auto-fix ESLint violations after every TypeScript/JavaScript file write.

hooks.name: post-tool:run-affected-tests
hooks.description: Run test suite for the modified module after every file write. Fast feedback loop.

hooks.name: pre-tool:block-eval-usage
hooks.command: echo '${fileContent}' | grep -n '\beval(' | grep -v '//\|test\|spec' && echo 'BLOCKED: eval() found — use safe alternative' && exit 1 || exit 0
hooks.description: BLOCKING hook: Prevents writing any file containing eval(). eval() is a zero-tolerance security violation.

hooks.name: pre-tool:block-float-money
hooks.command: echo '${fileContent}' | grep -n 'parseFloat.*[Pp]rice\|toFixed(2)\|\.toFixed\b' | grep -v 'mathService\|display\|test\|spec\|comment' && echo 'BLOCKED: float money operation detected — use integer cents' && exit 1 || exit 0
hooks.description: BLOCKING hook: Prevents writing backend/database files containing float money operations. Integer cents only.

hooks.name: pre-tool:block-any-type-frontend
hooks.command: echo '${fileContent}' | grep -n ': any\|as any\|<any>' | grep -v '//\|test\|spec\|eslint-disable' | head -5 && echo 'WARN: any type found in frontend — use unknown + narrowing'
hooks.description: Warns when `any` type is used in frontend TypeScript. Zero any types required.

hooks.name: pre-commit:full-quality-gate
hooks.command: set -euo pipefail && cd '${workspaceRoot}/2_MAIN_CODING_FILES' && echo '=== PRE-COMMIT GATE ===' && npx tsc --noEmit --strict && echo 'TSC:PASS' && npx eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx --max-warnings 0 && echo 'ESLint:PASS' && npm audit --audit-level=high && echo 'npm-audit:PASS' && npx jest --coverage --coverageThreshold='{"global":{"lines":85,"branches":85}}' --passWithNoTests=false --forceExit && echo 'Jest:PASS' && echo '=== ALL GATES PASSED ==='
hooks.description: BLOCKING pre-commit gate: tsc + eslint + npm audit + jest 85% coverage. All must pass. Commit refused on any failure.

hooks.name: pre-commit:secret-scan
hooks.command: git diff --cached --name-only | xargs grep -l -E '(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9_]{36}|sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]+|-----BEGIN (RSA |EC )?PRIVATE KEY-----)' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\.template\|\.example\|test\|spec' && echo 'BLOCKED: Hardcoded secret staged — remove before commit' && exit 1 || echo 'secret-scan:PASS'
hooks.description: BLOCKING: Scans staged files for API keys, private keys, GitHub tokens. Blocks commit if found.

hooks.name: pre-commit:env-not-staged
hooks.command: git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '^\.env$|^\.env\.' | grep -v '\.template\|\.example' && echo 'BLOCKED: .env file staged — run: git reset HEAD .env' && exit 1 || echo 'env-check:PASS'
hooks.description: BLOCKING: Prevents committing .env files. .env must remain gitignored at all times.

hooks.name: pre-commit:no-eval
hooks.command: git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=A | xargs grep -l '\beval(' 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'test\|spec\|vendor' && echo 'BLOCKED: eval() in staged files' && exit 1 || echo 'eval-check:PASS'
hooks.description: BLOCKING: Prevents committing any file containing eval(). Zero tolerance.

hooks.name: pre-commit:semgrep-sast
hooks.command: which semgrep &>/dev/null && semgrep scan --config=p/secrets --config=p/sql-injection --error --quiet . 2>&1 && echo 'semgrep:PASS' || echo 'semgrep:SKIP (not installed — install with: pip install semgrep)'
hooks.description: Run Semgrep SAST on staged files. Warns if semgrep not installed. Blocks on CRITICAL findings if installed.

hooks.name: post-tool:prisma-validate
hooks.command: cd '${workspaceRoot}/2_MAIN_CODING_FILES' && npx prisma validate && echo 'prisma-validate:PASS' || echo 'prisma-validate:FAIL — schema errors found'
hooks.description: Run Prisma schema validation after any schema.prisma or migration file write.

hooks.name: post-tool:float-money-scan
hooks.command: grep -n 'Float\|Decimal' '${changedFile}' | grep -v '//' && echo 'FAIL: Float/Decimal money type in Prisma schema — use Int' || echo 'money-type-check:PASS'
hooks.description: Scan Prisma schema for Float/Decimal money columns after every schema write.

hooks.name: pre-deploy:full-audit-gate
hooks.command: set -euo pipefail && cd '${workspaceRoot}/2_MAIN_CODING_FILES' && npx tsc --noEmit --strict && npm audit --audit-level=high && npx jest --passWithNoTests=false --coverageThreshold='{"global":{"lines":85}}' && cd '${workspaceRoot}' && git check-ignore .env && test -s USER_MANUAL.md && npx prisma migrate status 2>&1 | grep 'up to date' && echo 'DEPLOY-GATE:ALL_PASSED'
hooks.description: BLOCKING: Full deployment gate. Must pass before any deploy command executes: tsc + npm audit + jest ≥85% + .env gitignored + USER_MANUAL.md + no pending migrations.

hooks.name: post-build:generate-gate-report
hooks.command: node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.gate/build_timestamp.json', JSON.stringify({ built_at: new Date().toISOString(), exit_code: 0 }))" && echo 'gate-report:WRITTEN'
hooks.description: Write build timestamp to .gate/ after every successful build. Used by deployment gate to verify build freshness.
